arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/t1.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

ROUTES = {'https://demo.test': 'r1', 'http://a.test': 'r2',
          'http://a.test:8080': 'r3', 'https://[2001:db8::1]': 'r4',
          'http://10.0.0.1': 'r5'}

# ---- empty scenario
check('empty', {'routes': {}, 'events': []},
      {'streams': [], 'origins': {}}, {})

# ---- routes with unused origins
check('unused-origin', {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'u'}, 'events': []},
      {'streams': [], 'origins': {'u': ''}}, {'u': b''})

# ---- basic GET
ev = stream(0, base_fields())
check('basic-get', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'forwarded', commit_at=1, origin='r1', offset=0,
                       length=len(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'),
                       cache_key=['GET', 'https', 'demo.test', '/'])],
       'origins': {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()} | {'r1': b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'}},
      expect_origins={'r1': b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n',
                      'r2': b'', 'r3': b'', 'r4': b'', 'r5': b''})

# ---- sid sorting + origin offsets in FIN order
ev = (stream(8, base_fields(path='/s8', extra=[('x-a', '1')]))
      + stream(4, base_fields(path='/s4', authority='a.test', scheme='http'))
      + stream(12, base_fields(path='/s12')))
exp = b'GET /s8 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-a: 1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
exp4 = b'GET /s4 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: a.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
check('fin-order', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(4, 'forwarded', commit_at=3, origin='r2', offset=0, length=len(exp4), cache_key=['GET','http','a.test','/s4']),
                   rec(8, 'forwarded', commit_at=1, origin='r1', offset=0, length=len(exp), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/s8']),
                   rec(12, 'forwarded', commit_at=5, origin='r1', offset=len(exp), length=len(exp), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/s12'])],
       'origins': {'r1': exp + exp, 'r2': exp4, 'r3': b'', 'r4': b'', 'r5': b''}})

# ---- cancelled / incomplete / rejected nulls
ev = (stream(0, base_fields(), terminal='reset')
      + stream(4, base_fields(extra=[('bad', 'a\rb')]))
      + stream(8, base_fields()))
got = check('terminal-states', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'cancelled'), rec(4, 'rejected'), rec(8, 'incomplete')],
       'origins': {'r1': b'', 'r2': b'', 'r3': b'', 'r4': b'', 'r5': b''}})

# ---- unknown frames ignored everywhere
ev = (stream(0, unknown=[(33, 'aa'), (0, ''), (13, 'ff')], fields=base_fields(path='/u'),
            data=['0102'], unknown2=None))
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 33, 'hex': 'aa'}]
      + stream(0, fields=base_fields(path='/u'), data=['0102'],
               trailing=[['x-audit-t', 'v']])
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 64, 'hex': '0000'}])
body = b'ab'
want = (b'GET /u HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        b'trailer: x-audit-t\r\n\r\n2\r\n' + body + b'\r\n0\r\nx-audit-t: v\r\n\r\n')
check('unknown-ignored', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'forwarded', commit_at=6, origin='r1', offset=0, length=len(want), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/u'])],
       'origins': {'r1': want, 'r2': b'', 'r3': b'', 'r4': b'', 'r5': b''}})

# ---- data before headers -> rejected
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'data', 'hex': '00'}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}])
check('data-first', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'rejected')], 'origins': {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()}})

# ---- fin with no headers
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}])
check('fin-only', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'rejected')], 'origins': {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()}})

# ---- third headers
ev = (stream(0, fields=base_fields(), trailing=[])[:1]
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []}] + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}])
check('third-headers', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'rejected')], 'origins': {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()}})

# ---- data after trailing headers
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': base_fields()},
       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []},
       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'data', 'hex': '00'},
       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}])
check('data-after-trailer', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      {'streams': [rec(0, 'rejected')], 'origins': {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()}})

summary()
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t1.py
